inlines.v: LOMENTA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin lomentum, bean meal, a color.] Furnished with a loment. The lomentaceae are a natural order of plants, many of which furnish beautiful tinctures or dyes, and whose seeds are contained in a loment or legume.
